verdict.rationale: The evidence pack explicitly probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec (docs.adyen.com/openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) and all candidate paths return 404, with no alternative machine-readable spec link surfaced in the docs pages. While Adyen exposes an llms.txt index, that is not an OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, so there is no evidence the Issuing API spec is downloadable in a machine-readable format.
